column1: # Test fixture audio manifest — same shape as models/manifest.tsv (ADR-006's
# checksummed-manifest pattern), applied to a committed third-party recording
# instead of a fetched-on-demand model asset. See ATTRIBUTION.md for full
# provenance. tests/test_birdnet_fixture.py verifies this checksum before
# using the file, so a corrupted or silently-swapped fixture fails loudly
# rather than producing a misleading pass or fail.
